title: About - OpenBitcoin
metaDescription: OpenBitcoin.com is a Bitcoin-only block explorer and toolset running on its own full node, supported by advertising and operated independently.
lede: OpenBitcoin.com is a Bitcoin-only block explorer with live prices, fee estimates, and related tools, run on its own infrastructure by an independent operator.

sections.heading: What this is
sections.html:
OpenBitcoin.com is a Bitcoin-only block explorer with live prices, fee estimates, and a set of related tools. There are no user accounts and nothing to sign up for. The scope of the site is published in full:

Bitcoin the monetary network. No tokens, no inscriptions, no presales. No altcoin prices, charts, tools, or recommendations anywhere on this site. One exception, stated plainly: /swap supports cross-asset swaps, because moving value from other coins into bitcoin is something our users actually do. That's its only job.

sections.heading: How it runs
sections.html: The site runs its own Bitcoin Core full node and chain index. Block, transaction, and address data is read from that node, not from a third-party API. The displayed bitcoin price is a median of three exchanges, and the price and fee series are recorded and stored on the site's own infrastructure. Where each figure comes from is documented at /sources.

sections.heading: How it is supported
sections.html: The site is supported by advertising, affiliate links, sponsorship, and tips. It may display advertising from third-party ad networks; ad content comes from the networks that serve it and is not an endorsement. Some outbound links are affiliate links that pay the site a commission. Sponsorship inquiries can be made through the contact page. Voluntary tips are accepted. Sponsored and affiliate placements are labeled where they appear, as described at /disclosure.

sections.heading: Independent operation
sections.html: OpenBitcoin.com is independently operated and is not affiliated with any exchange, wallet vendor, or other company. The operator maintains the site anonymously and is reachable at the contact address below.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.html: Email: inbox@openbitcoin.com. This inbox is monitored and handles all inquiries, including privacy requests, abuse reports, and legal notices.
